## Exposure 1: Hagg
``` {r read_in_hagg}

exposure_path_hagg = "/wynton/group/andrews/data/summary_stats/results/Hagg2020mtdnacn.chrall.CPRA_b37.tsv.gz"

mtDNAcn_hagg <- read_tsv(exposure_path_hagg,comment="#")


# To format the GWAS results for MR analysis Exposure. 
# Rename right-side variables to match column names of your GWAS dataset.
Format_mtDNAcn_hagg <- mtDNAcn_hagg %>% format_data(.,
  type = "exposure",
  snps = NULL,
  header = TRUE,
  phenotype_col = "TRAIT",
  snp_col = "DBSNP_ID",
  beta_col = "BETA",
  se_col = "SE",
  eaf_col = "AF",
  effect_allele_col = "REF",
  other_allele_col = "ALT",
  pval_col = "P",
  units_col = "units",
  ncase_col = "N_CASES",
  ncontrol_col = "N_CTRLS",
  samplesize_col = "N",
  gene_col = "gene",
  min_pval = 1e-200,
  z_col = "Z",
  info_col = "info",
  chr_col = "CHROM",
  pos_col = "POS",
  log_pval = FALSE
)  %>%
  as_tibble()


Format_mtDNAcn_hagg <- Format_mtDNAcn_hagg %>%
mutate(exposure = "mtDNA_hagg")


# Hagg Filter and Clumping
options(ieugwasr_api = 'gwas-api.mrcieu.ac.uk/')

mtDNAcn_hagg_gws <- filter(Format_mtDNAcn_hagg, pval.exposure < 5e-8)


mtDNAcn_clump_hagg <- clump_data(mtDNAcn_hagg_gws, clump_kb = 10000,
                            clump_r2 = 0.001,
                            clump_p1 = 1,
                            clump_p2 = 1,
                            pop = "EUR"
)%>% 
  as_tibble()

#Remove APOE region
mtDNAcn_clump_hagg <- filter(mtDNAcn_clump_hagg, !(chr.exposure == 19 & between(pos.exposure, 44912079, 45912079)))
```

## Outcome: Bellenguez
```{r load in Bellenguez AD dataset}
outcome_path_bellenguez = "/wynton/group/andrews/data/summary_stats/results/Bellenguez2022load.chrall.CPRA_b37.tsv.gz"

# Import Code for outcome GWAS 
OutcomeAD_Bellenguez <- read_tsv(outcome_path_bellenguez,comment="#")

# Rename right-side variables to match column names of your GWAS dataset 
outcome_AD_Format_Bellenguez <- OutcomeAD_Bellenguez %>%
  format_data(.,
    type = "outcome",
    snps = NULL,
    header = TRUE,
    phenotype_col = "Phenotype",
    snp_col = "DBSNP_ID",
    beta_col = "BETA",
    se_col = "SE",
    eaf_col = "AF",
    effect_allele_col = "ALT",
    other_allele_col = "REF",
    pval_col = "P",
    samplesize_col = "N",
    z_col = "Z",
    chr_col = "CHROM",
    pos_col = "POS",
    log_pval = FALSE
) %>%
  as_tibble()

outcome_AD_Format_Bellenguez <- outcome_AD_Format_Bellenguez %>%
mutate(outcome = "bellenguez")
```

#LD proxy SNPs
```{r}
# extract hagg SNPs present in outcome
exposure_clump_hagg <- semi_join(
 outcome_AD_Format_Bellenguez, mtDNAcn_clump_hagg, by = "SNP"
)

# Hagg SNPs not present in outcome
exp_snps_wo <- anti_join(
  mtDNAcn_clump_hagg, outcome_AD_Format_Bellenguez, by = "SNP"
) #2 SNPs

# Use LDLinkR to identify proxy snps
LDproxy_batch(exp_snps_wo$SNP, 
        pop = "CEU", 
        r2d = "r2", 
        token = 'a6deee62cc4a', 
        append = TRUE,
        genome_build = "grch37")
system("mv combined_query_snp_list_grch37.txt exposure_outcome_proxy_snps_hagg_bellenguez_Aadrita.txt")

# Munge proxy snp file
outcome_dat <- munge_proxies("/wynton/group/andrews/users/achatterjee/mtdnacn/Brian-Estimating-Causality-mtDNAcn-on-Alzheimer/data/proxy_snps/exposure_outcome_proxy_snps_hagg_bellenguez_Aadrita.txt", outcome_AD_Format_Bellenguez, exposure_clump_hagg)
```

#MR
```{r}
mr_res <- mr(harmonised_data, method_list = c(
  "mr_two_sample_ml",  "mr_egger_regression", "mr_weighted_median", 
  "mr_ivw_fe", "mr_ivw_mre",
  "mr_simple_mode", "mr_weighted_mode"
  ))

res_single <- mr_singlesnp(harmonised_data, all_method = c("mr_ivw_fe", "mr_egger_regression", "mr_weighted_median", "mr_weighted_mode")) %>% as_tibble()

```

##Sensitivity analyses
```{r}
mr_heterogeneity(harmonised_data)
mr_pleiotropy_test(harmonised_data)
```

##Radial MR
```{r}
radial_dat <- harmonised_data %>% filter(mr_keep == T) %>% dat_to_RadialMR()
radial_res <- ivw_radial(radial_dat$mtDNA_hagg.bellenguez, alpha = 0.05/nrow(radial_dat$mtDNA_hagg.bellenguez)) #no significant outliers
```
#MRLap
```{r}
#remotes::install_github("n-mounier/MRlap")
library(MRlap)

#Reformatting exposure
reformat_mtDNAcn_hagg <- mtDNAcn_hagg %>% 
  rename(rsid = "DBSNP_ID", chr = "CHROM", ) %>% 
  select(-OR)

#Reformatting outcome
outcome <- OutcomeAD_Bellenguez %>% 
  dplyr::rename(rs = DBSNP_ID, chr = CHROM) %>% 
  select(-OR) %>% 
  filter(rs != 'rs429358')

mrlap <- MRlap(exposure = reformat_mtDNAcn_hagg,
               exposure_name = "exposure",
               outcome = outcome,
               outcome_name = "outcome",
               MR_pruning_dist = 10000,
               MR_pruning_LD = 0.001,
               ld = "/wynton/group/andrews/data/eur_w_ld_chr/",
               hm3 = "/wynton/group/andrews/data/w_hm3.snplist")
mrlap

mrlap$MRcorrection$IVs

filter(outcome, rs %in% mrlap$MRcorrection$IVs)

```
